description: Returns the Moon's phase, percent lit, lunar age and waxing or waning direction right now, at 12:00 on a date, or at a clock time on a date, in a time zone or city. Also returns the next new Moon, first quarter, full Moon and last quarter, the previous full Moon and the moment the phase name changes. Dates run from 1900 to 2100.

date.description: Local calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900 to 2100. Without a date and a time the result describes the Moon right now; a date alone gives the Moon at 12:00 local time.

place.description: A city from the website's list of 136 world cities, such as Tokyo, Chicago or Cairo; its time zone is used unless timeZone is given.

time.description: Local clock time as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock. Without a date it refers to today in the chosen time zone.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone name such as America/New_York or Asia/Tokyo; UTC when omitted.

name: get_moon_phase
title: Moon phase
